about_the_game:
Blunatic is a grimdark dystopian visual novel.

THE STORY
You play Blunatic, a BLUE creature in underwear with a foul mouth that loves to go against the Establishment.

The Establishment is run by Kai Devilson of the Devilson clan. They're a bunch of brutal, brutal RED creatures who also wear underwear, who enslave all Blunatics.

Now, Kai Devilson really did a number on you. Could be NUMBER 1 or NUMBER 2. It's unclear.

What's clear is, Blunatic want REVENGE.

THE GAME PLAY
Play as the main character and take control of all the decision-making in the game.
Explore different branches of the story. Discover parts of the story that will blow your mind.
Make choices in this visual novel to get said REVENGE.
Curse, deceive, slaughter your enemies.

FEATURES
Simple point and click system.
Realistic bone animations and movements that bring characters to life.
Select choices to shape the outcome that you want.
Replay the game to explore different paths.

CLOSING REMARKS
Look, I'm not sure if you've even made it to this sentence. But, the scenes are BRUTAL. There will be BLOOD. Turn away if you can't take it.

content_descriptors.notes: The general tone of the game is grimdark dystopian. It portrays a fantasy setting where everything is dark, hopeless and surviving on a day to day basis is ridiculously hard if not impossible.
